This is TTLock's MIT-licensed Flutter SDK 0.3.8 from pub.dev, vendored for reproducible mobile builds. The upstream LICENSE is retained.

AirLink changes:
- Android build configuration uses the host application's Android Gradle Plugin, Google/Maven Central repositories and SDK 37. Removed obsolete JCenter and AGP 4.1.2 setup.
- No modifications to Bluetooth protocol or bundled native lock library.

Upstream: https://pub.dev/packages/ttlock_flutter/versions/0.3.8
